content.short: Strike Finance is a decentralized derivatives protocol on Cardano for on-chain options and futures trading.
content.description: Strike Finance is a pioneering decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol built on the Cardano blockchain, designed to bring advanced derivative instruments to the network. The platform enables users to trade options, forwards, and perpetual futures directly on-chain, providing essential tools for risk management and leveraged positions. With its Strike V2 architecture and dedicated execution layer, the protocol ensures high-frequency trading and sub-second order matching. By bridging the gap between traditional finance and blockchain, Strike Finance empowers traders with a secure marketplace.
